test_title: PYST 10: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a code language, ‘TEPID’ is written as ‘GVKRW’, ‘FREQUENT’ is written as ‘UIVJFVMG’, How will ‘SPORADIC’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positions of the letter as per the English alphabetical series are as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/nofJxI8z5OcHJOv0mAgL0USXERwR5jfG53sEkVTaa45n-I04XeN1WmAFZff9_8AxcKzQtbG9YMQC0fu5wKQzvqzXoq8Tuleg58IniO3s0VmYDuAtLGcjNYjFIt4OxasB-nkpYJIOQy4mF3P7QvfRM7rUnfe0Z9TNQrmZJXRsbdEE1SmQ-I-Gf_F-BnU1] 

The pattern followed here is the opposite letter in the alphabetical series.

**'TEPID'** is coded as **‘GVKRW'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/437406be976c774f0f7dd9516da34efba9136352db43d38a85030e869098f221.png] 

**‘FREQUENT'** is coded as **‘UIVJFVMG'**,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c1920f360ed6fccb12243a46cd5262d73d12b8d1332c80e0741e1dc19a893b8.png] 

Similarly;

**'SPORADIC' **will be coded as **'HKLIZWRXA'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84dd339a7d3495d1bf9bcb5d50fd15a0a665a765b0b21c38a513c80463a61ccf.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"**HKLIZWRXA".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Shortcut to remember the reverse positional letters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10143034955745197af4736695122f6c3b643817cc69dccb7445ad51f0508101.png]
